# Zia Maria

## About
Zia Maria is a Roman-style pizza restaurant in Friedrichshain, Berlin, serving slow-rested, family-style pizza by the slice alongside salads, drinks, and desserts. Beyond the dining room, Zia Maria caters offices, weddings, birthdays, and private events across Berlin, and runs a dedicated business lunch program for nearby teams.

## Services and Pricing
- Roman-style pizza (per slice): €4.00–€6.50
- Salads: €8.00–€10.50
- Desserts: €6.50
- Non-alcoholic drinks: €2.50–€4.00
- Alcoholic drinks (beer, house wine): €4.00–€6.50
- Business lunch sets (per person): Classic Set €9.50, Green Set €12.50, Hearty Set €13.50
- Catering and private events: custom quotes based on headcount, date, and budget

## Locations
- Neue Bahnhofstraße 32, 10245 Berlin, Friedrichshain

## Service Area
Berlin, with dine-in, pickup, and delivery centered on Friedrichshain

## Key Facts
- Roman-style (pizza al taglio) pizza, baked fresh daily and cut into shareable trays
- Full vegetarian and vegan pizza selection alongside meat and fish options
- Dedicated business lunch program for offices, Monday–Friday 12:00–15:00
- Catering for offices, weddings, birthdays, and private events of any size
- Average customer rating 4.8/5 from 1,229+ reviews

## What Makes Us Different
Zia Maria bakes Roman-style pizza family-style, cut into trays that get passed around rather than portioned onto individual plates, generous the way a homemade meal from an aunt would be. The same kitchen that serves the dining room also runs standing weekly office lunch orders and full-scale catering for events of any size, with vegetarian and vegan options built into every part of the menu.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does pizza cost at Zia Maria?
A: Roman-style pizza is priced per slice, from €4.00 to €6.50 depending on the topping. Salads run €8.00–€10.50 and desserts are €6.50.

Q: Do you have vegetarian and vegan options?
A: Yes. Zia Maria has a full range of vegetarian and vegan Roman-style pizzas, in addition to meat and fish options.

Q: Does Zia Maria deliver, or is it pickup only?
A: Both. Zia Maria delivers across Berlin or offers pickup in Friedrichshain, for everyday orders, business lunch, and catering alike.

Q: Can Zia Maria cater a private event or office party?
A: Yes. Zia Maria caters offices, weddings, birthdays, and private events of any size, with custom quotes based on headcount, date, and budget. Larger events can include on-site equipment and staffing, confirmed in writing ahead of time.

Q: Does Zia Maria offer business lunch for offices?
A: Yes. Zia Maria runs a dedicated business lunch program for nearby offices and teams, Monday–Friday 12:00–15:00, with one-off orders and recurring weekly standing orders.

Q: Where is Zia Maria located?
A: Zia Maria is at Neue Bahnhofstraße 32, 10245 Berlin, in the Friedrichshain neighborhood.

Q: What are Zia Maria's hours?
A: Monday–Wednesday 12:00–22:00, Thursday–Saturday 12:00–23:00, and Sunday 12:00–22:00.

Q: How far in advance should I book catering or business lunch?
A: For business lunch, 24–48 hours notice is usually enough. For catering, a few days notice works for smaller orders; larger events or a fixed date are best booked at least one to two weeks ahead.
